about: The one machine-readable record of where every source file in the repository sits, organised like her crystals. docs/LAYER_MODULE_OWNERSHIP.md is generated from it by scripts/render_module_ownership.py, and the knowledge graph reads it. Domains, subsystems, layers and duties are claims of intent; composites and exercises are derived from import evidence. Nothing in it moves a file.

ladder.name: Quasi
ladder.holds: A domain: desktop Aurora, the phone app, the ACM, and the repository's CI.

ladder.name: Higher order
ladder.holds: A subsystem inside a domain. Desktop's are the function categories.

ladder.name: Composite
ladder.holds: Files that import evidence joins inside one subsystem.

scope.covers: every source file in the repository
scope.statement: Covers every source file in the repository: desktop Aurora's Python (runtime, scripts and tests), the phone app's Dart, Kotlin, Java and Python, the ACM's Rust and Python, launchers, service units, prototypes and CI workflows. Data, state, documentation and build configuration are not source and are listed below.

not_covered.path: aurora_state/, aurora_state_test/, aurora_logs/, vector_data/, lessons/, aurora_genealogy/
not_covered.what: Runtime state, logs, lessons and genealogy data
Documentation, install notes and build reports
Maps, audits, manifests and run history

not_covered.path: Cargo.toml, pubspec.yaml, Gradle files, buildozer.spec, requirements and pytest.ini

basis.reviewed: Its code and its importers were read; duties says what it actually does.
basis.name_and_docstring: Assigned from its name and docstring, then screened by the import and file-write scan, which raised no conflict.
basis.location: Assigned from where the file sits and its name (tests/, scripts/, the phone app's and the ACM's folders).

evidence_rules.composite_rule: A composite is a connected group of two or more files in one subsystem, joined by import edges that stay inside that subsystem. Edges come from Python imports (desktop by dotted path from the repo root, other domains by module name in their own folder), Dart imports, Rust mod declarations and crate, super and self paths, and Kotlin or Java class names used in the same folder. Shell, batch, PowerShell, HTML, JSX, systemd and workflow files have no import edges here, so they stay base files. A composite is named after its subsystem and numbered by size; its hub is the member with the most links inside it. A candidate the knowledge graph marks import_only is not promoted; it is listed under composite_candidates and its files stay base files.

aurora_interaction_engine.py.duties: Interaction-lineage compression semantics: the facet sets and InteractionQuasiInnerStrata the interaction crystals use. Booted by aurora.py.

aurora_interaction_processing.py.duties: Interaction crystal formation, promotion, collapse and routing. aurora.py boots InteractionProcessing; its crystals subclass the QuasiArch crystal types.

aurora_internal/aurora_boot_parity.py.duties: Tracks parity between aurora.py boot_aurora and aurora_runtime.py boot_stack. Only tests use it.

aurora_internal/aurora_episode_slip_prof.duties: EpisodeRubricSummary feeds structural-pressure steering, the specialized avatar synthesizer and the dream genealogy bridge.

aurora_internal/aurora_fault_audit.py.duties: AST audit for swallowed exceptions, used by the fault instrumentation script and tests.

aurora_internal/aurora_local_llm_bridge..duties: Fail-closed guard: the retired local-model adapter keeps its names so stale imports fail closed, and there is no model path. Only tests import it.

aurora_internal/aurora_pf1_5_instruments.duties: wellformed_and_coherent decides whether a candidate reply is accepted, in aurora.py and aurora_working_memory.py. Measuring PF1.5 is its second job.

aurora_internal/aurora_quasiarch_observe.duties: The QuasiArch observer, a live organ: aurora.py boots it at L8+, it runs during boot and every turn, and it writes its own state under aurora_state/quasiarch_observer (runtime_state.json, which aurora_hub.py and aurora_diag.py read; interventions; ghost relics). Its query answers carry authoritative False. In gated mode only (AURORA_QUASIARCH_MODE=gated; advisory is the default), advise_training_plan() writes qao_mutation_signal.json once doctrine confidence passes the gate, and the daemon's _select_discovery_driven_operator reads it, marks it consumed and may take its operator hint as the next code mutation. So it is an input to the daemon as well as an observer.

aurora_internal/aurora_runtime_health.py.duties: Readiness semantics (degraded is not ready unless a caller opts in). Not wired into the runtime: tests and the fault audit use it.

aurora_internal/aurora_semantic_probe_ba.duties: Its function-word set _STRONG_FUNCTION_WORDS is used by aurora_proposition_frame.py and aurora_constraint_semantic_continuity.py, and its _parseable check by aurora_expression_perception.py. The probe battery itself is diagnostic.

aurora_internal/aurora_stack_trace_instr.duties: instrument_stack wraps runtime methods to record call lineage when AURORA_STACK_TRACE is on. Off by default.

aurora_internal/aurora_surface_doc.py.duties: full_report() gives aurora_surface_dispatcher.py its axis-to-surface routing table, and it writes a pressure log.

aurora_internal/aurora_system_introspect.duties: Source-derived map of executable functions (function ids are module.qualname) and per-turn decision provenance. aurora.py boots it and connects it to perception; it writes its own state and does not change response selection.

aurora_internal/dual_strata/perturbation.duties: Run by the topological semantic coordinator through run_perturbation_probe.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_development_in.duties: Development inquiry helper for the QuasiArch observer. It runs wherever the observer runs, which includes the phone app's runtime.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_observer/__ini.duties: Re-exports the package. aurora_interaction_processing.py imports CrystalInstance and CrystalOrder through it, which loads every submodule when interaction processing boots.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_observer/cryst.duties: Crystal law: what each facet and relational point means at each crystal order (CrystalEngine, FacetLaw, RelationalPointLaw, CrystalOrder). QuasiArch reads it, and CrystalOrder is also the order ladder of the live interaction crystals in aurora_interaction_processing.py, so it is operational, not only investigative.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_observer/dimen.duties: QuasiArch lineage memory (DimensionalMemory, IntegratedMemoryPipeline). Only the QuasiArch observer calls it, and it runs during boot and turns because the observer does.

CrystalInstance, RelationalPoint, crystal formation and promotion. InteractionCrystalInstance in aurora_interaction_processing.py subclasses CrystalInstance and builds RelationalPoint objects, and aurora.py boots InteractionProcessing, so these types hold live state.

aurora_internal/quasiarch_observer/ghost.duties: Ghost relic records (GhostRelic, GhostRelicSystem). Only the QuasiArch observer calls it; it runs at boot when the observer starts.

aurora_learning_probe.py.duties: LearningProbe, a live organ on the phone: the phone app's aurora_bridge.py starts it as systems['learning_probe'] and it appends to aurora_state/learning_probe.jsonl. Nothing on desktop imports it.

conftest.py.duties: pytest setup only: puts the repository root on sys.path for tests/. Not part of the runtime.

flutter_app/android/app/src/main/python/.duties: Chaquopy entry point that AuroraService.kt calls. It boots the root aurora.py stack and exposes text in and text out, so audio stays on the Kotlin and Flutter side.

Rehearsal environment that scores her rehearsed reply against what was really said next. aurora.py's change lineage names it as a target file, and tests import it by module name, so desktop depends on it too.
Android stand-in for opencv: numpy and Pillow versions of the cv2 calls her stack uses, with camera frames fed in from the Kotlin CameraX bridge.

reply_aurora.py.duties: Command-line script Sir runs by hand from a terminal: it appends his reply to aurora_state/correspondence/from_sunni.jsonl using the correspondence loop's own helpers, and aurora_internal/aurora_correspondence_loop.py reads that file the next time the loop runs. No entry point, boot path or production importer reaches it, so it is tooling, not runtime; nothing imports it, and the loop and its test only name it in their docstrings.

run_full_competency_gauntlet.py.duties: Script entry point for the competency gauntlet. It writes aurora_state/last_full_competency_gauntlet.json. Nothing in covered code imports it.

run_gauntlet.py.duties: Script entry point that starts the daemon and runs the gauntlet. It opens aurora_state/daemon.log and hands it to the daemon process as stdout and stderr, as aurora_hub.py and the other launchers do, so the log's lines are the daemon's own output; aurora_metabolic_distiller.py reads and trims that log as one of its residue sources. It also writes its own results under aurora_state. Nothing in covered code imports it.

run_probe_battery.py.duties: Script entry point for the semantic probe battery. It boots against a scratch copy of aurora_state and writes results to aurora_state/probe_battery/results/. Nothing in covered code imports it.

graph_evidence.source: Knowledge graph, PR #263 at commit 099d43f: knowledge_graph/coverage/composites.json and claims.json.
graph_evidence.note: What the knowledge graph found when it checked this record. A composite the graph marks import_only (no call, flow, spawn or shared state joins its files) is not promoted: it stays a candidate and its files stay base files. Cross-domain links are evidence-backed candidates for higher-order links; none is promoted without Sir's word.
